rationale: Exp2 (eval seed 20) selected stage3 @ 38,000 dots with a passing paired-CI gate, but that same seed was used for selection. Exp3 is a confirmatory replication on a FRESH evaluation hide-draw (seed 31) of a strengthened recipe, with the candidate (stage, budget) fixed in advance from Exp2.
changes_vs_exp2: stage-1 channels: 26 -> 44 (adds 10 mirrored 1 m-LiDAR scarp channels and 8 GeoDAWN radiometric channels/ratios + upward-continued TMI; SGMC fault raster, lidar strike and lidar valid excluded)
auto-context offsets: (1,3,7,15) -> (1,2,3,5,8,12,15) px along/across local orientation (the lane spec's +-1..15 px set)
model-seed bagging: 2 LightGBM seeds (68, 71) averaged at every stage; rounds 220 -> 180
unchanged_from_exp2: hide-and-recover protocol: buffered whole-component LOQO, 12 px outer buffer, catalogue-context from visible faults only
stage>=2 hide-draw label protocol (positives = withheld components of training draws)
emission rule: exclude <=2 px from visible catalogue, 5x5 local maxima, top-N binary dots
evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2 (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel)
gate: Candidate passes iff the paired spatial-block bootstrap 95% CI for HOLDOUT-DTI(candidate)-HOLDOUT-DTI(stage1) lies entirely above 0 on BOTH the full domain and the >1 km-from-visible-catalogue (far) domain, on the fresh seed-31 evaluation. Stage2 and other budgets are reported but do NOT substitute for the candidate.
leakage_canary: Every stage-2 input channel tested alone (AUC vs withheld truth on outer predictions); AUC > 0.90 (or < 0.10) flags leakage and blocks promotion.
decision_rule: Gate pass + canary clean -> build final full-catalogue LOQO maps with the identical recipe, emit 38,000 dots, run uniqueness (Spearman < 0.90 and <70% dots within 3 px vs every registry raster AND every prior GEMSDOE68 download, density-degenerate rasters named explicitly), validate, and offer ONE download marked OK TO SUBMIT. Gate fail -> log negative result, mark site DO NOT SUBMIT for this experiment, spend no submission slot.
named_non_fault_mimic: Range-front / basin-margin erosional escarpments and shoreline terraces: the LiDAR scarp and detrended-elevation channels respond to them as to fault scarps, radiometric K contrasts occur at volcanic-flow boundaries, and the auto-context stage rewards connecting them into continuous lineaments.
